name: Voices
source:
"How much can life change in just one week?

How much of ourselves do we actually show to others?

Can we really judge someone else and the choices they've made just because we think we know them?

Owen is a writer who became famous from his very first book, a book that lead him far from home. Even to conventions in other countries. 

But writing isn't Owen's only interest: he's always loved conventions, so this opportunity he has is perfect. Thanks to his books, he'll be attending an event he's been waiting for: an interview with his favorite voice actor, Faun.

However, Owen still doesn't know his best friend is planning a bigger surprise. After the event he's going to meet Lionel, another fan who attended the interview, and the two seemingly hit it off right away.

But their meeting isn't by chance, even if they don't know it yet...

Dominated by crushing secrets, their own wounded souls, and an unexpected attraction, they'll have to work to come to terms with their pasts to be able to live their lives free from the mask they've worn for so long."

[From [url=https://jo-way.itch.io/voicesvn]Itch.io[/url]]
